q: Which excavating machine has a digging bucket on a two-part articulated arm, usually mounted at the rear of a tractor or front loader?
n: A backhoe's arm sits at the rear of a tractor, often paired with a front loader bucket.

q: Which heavy equipment clears vegetation and pushes large volumes of soil during site preparation?
n: The dozer blade pushes soil and debris.

q: Which equipment is best for leveling and grading large areas of land during site development?
n: A motor grader's long blade trims surfaces to grade.

q: Which machine compacts soil, gravel or asphalt before construction?
n: Rollers densify subgrade and paving layers.

q: Which equipment is designed for digging deep, narrow trenches for pipes and cables?
n: Trenchers cut narrow slots with a chain or wheel.

q: What should be done first, before setting up batter boards and staking?
o: Verify that the boundary monuments are in the correct position
Build workers' quarters and material storage
n: Layout depends on correct boundary monuments, so verify them first.

q: On a sloping job site, where should excavation begin?
o: At the sides of the lot
n: Starting low lets water drain away from the work.

q: When is "lason" (soil poisoning) applied?
n: Soil poisoning is anti-termite treatment.

q: How is backfill material commonly estimated on site?
n: Fill is a volume quantity, measured in cubic meters.

q: Why is CHB the most commonly used masonry unit in the Philippines?
n: It is cheap and available everywhere.

q: Which is NOT a common CHB size?
n: Standard CHB comes in 4", 6" and 8".

q: How many cells does a standard CHB have?
n: Standard local CHB has three cells.

q: Which of these should NOT bear on a non-load-bearing masonry wall?
n: Roof framing should go on the structural frame, not on CHB infill.

q: What is the binder in mortar and grout?
n: Portland cement binds both.

q: How many CHB are needed per square meter of wall?
What is the most common masonry work in Philippine construction?
n: CHB walls dominate local building.

q: What rebar size is typically used in 8" CHB walls?
n: Heavier 8" walls typically take 12 mm bars.

q: What rebar size is typically used in 4" CHB walls?
n: 10 mm bars suit thin partition walls.

q: What masonry wall combines CHB and brick bonded together?
n: Composite walls bond different units into one wall.

q: Why are steel bars placed even in non-load-bearing masonry walls?
n: Reinforcement holds the wall together under seismic shaking.

q: What is the most common mortar in Philippine masonry work?
n: Cement-sand mortar is the norm.

q: Which mortar type is permitted only for non-load-bearing walls?
n: Type K is the weakest mortar and is limited to non-bearing work.

q: What is the main advantage of steel deck?
o: It adds reinforcement to the floor
n: Deck acts as permanent formwork.

q: Which of these has the highest carbon content?
n: Cast iron has about 2–4% carbon.

q: What device adjusts the tension or length of cables and tie rods?
n: Turning the turnbuckle body tightens both rods.

q: What are the main top and bottom members of a steel truss called?
n: Chords carry the main forces; webs connect them.

q: Which steel connection is preferred for assembling steel parking structures quickly?
n: Bolting is fast and needs no field welding.

q: Which steel section is most used for skylight framing?
n: Tubes are neat and torsionally stiff.

q: Which steel section best suits an exposed roof truss?
n: Tubes look clean and are easy to paint.

q: What is a major advantage of tubular steel sections?
n: Tubes give a neat, exposed look.

q: Which structure typically uses tubular steel for both strength and looks?
n: Exposed canopies and atriums show off tube frames.

q: What is a main fabrication challenge with tubular steel trusses?
n: Tube-to-tube joints need profiled cuts and full welds.

q: Which is NOT a usual name for a stainless steel finish?
n: Stainless finishes are named satin, mirror, hairline, bead blast.

q: Which is NOT a characteristic of stainless steel?
n: Stainless resists rust through chromium, not galvanizing.

q: Which stainless steel finish is common for railings?
n: Hairline is the usual brushed railing finish.

q: Which stainless steel grade is the general-purpose standard?
n: Type 304 is the everyday grade.

q: Which stainless grade is best for coastal or marine settings?
n: 316 has molybdenum against chlorides.
